reviews.text: First time for my 5-month-old puppy, Thétis. Everything went wonderfully. Aela was fantastic with her. She also gave me lots of advice and reassured me about how to care for her daily. Thank you so much!
First grooming session with my Westie, perfect service, thank you very much to Maëva.
Thank you Maeva! This was our dogs first time being groomed here and I was worried because she is nervous. The full groom was completed quickly and she looks beautiful. Would reccomend!
Very nice people

Aela looked after my 13-year-old Shetland pony, she took great care of him (knowing he doesn't like water) and he looks so handsome and smells wonderful! I highly recommend her for your furry friends.
Very satisfied with this salon. They're the only ones with the patience to take care of our little chihuahua, who isn't always easy.

Thank you so much for taking such good care of Hera. I'm delighted.
She wasn't stressed at all when I came to pick her up.
She came out exactly as we hoped.
I love how you handle older, slightly dramatic dogs. 🤣 I'll definitely be back in October as planned.
Thanks again for your wonderful care and patience.
We were delighted with the grooming done on our two Akitas. You can feel the owner's passion for animals. She was gentle and patient with them. The service was excellent value for money!
Thank you so much!!

I'm giving one star because you can't give zero! I took my 5-month-old white British Shorthair in for a full grooming and I'm very, very, very disappointed.

I picked him up wet, with brown, dirty ears and disgusting eyes.

We had to redo everything at home.
The dead hair wasn't even removed.
€50 for this, honestly, avoid at all costs!! Grooming at other salons has been clearly better!!

I'm so happy with my cat Iris's grooming. Even though he's used to it, Aela immediately put him at ease and pampered him to reassure him... I highly recommend this salon, which is run by someone who adores and cares for our little four-legged wonders. I'll definitely be back!!! Thank you again for your tact and kindness!

A wonderful experience! The groomer was very attentive to our cat's reactions. We left with a beautiful little cat, completely free of knots!
Thank you so much, we'll definitely be back! 🐱 …
She's been my little Lilas's groomer for several appointments now. I entrust my dog ​​to her without hesitation.

As a regular client for my Miniature American Shepherd, Vasco, I highly recommend the services of "Coin à Truffes." The service is always exceptional, and the grooming is top-quality at reasonable prices. Thank you to the team for your fantastic work, and see you soon!
I brought my cat in for a grooming session and everything went very well; the groomer was gentle and reassuring.

This is the first time I've taken Maya to Le Coin à Truffes. It's a very special experience to remove her knots after wearing the cone. She's so clean and smells wonderful! Maya is beautiful again 😍 I highly recommend this grooming salon, Le Coin à Truffes, located just behind Galeries Lafayette in Lyon Part-Dieu. …

My Maine Coon's first experience at a groomer's was absolutely fantastic! I highly recommend this salon. I had the pleasure of meeting two incredible people, both professionally and personally.
My cat's fur tangles easily despite my regular brushing. His first knots had been removed by a vet, but my cat was terrified of the clippers, so I was worried he wouldn't tolerate the noise a second time. Not at all! These two professionals at the salon found the right techniques to gently remove his knots with the clippers, making sure my cat felt comfortable. They clearly love and know their job.
The salon layout is great if you want to watch the grooming process.

First grooming session at a salon for my sensitive/fearful/anxious Belgian Malinois.
Aela was perfect during our appointment! She listened carefully to my dog's history and body language! The experience was a complete success! I highly recommend her and will definitely be back because he came out even more handsome (and smelled wonderful)!

The smell of the place is very unpleasant.

I requested a grooming service for my Chihuahua, and he left with a completely uneven cut.
Because of the filth, he woke up today with dermatitis.

Furthermore, the tail area wasn't even trimmed.
I do not recommend this place.

We were delighted with our visit to this dog grooming salon. It's very conveniently located right next to Westfield La Part-Dieu, one of the largest shopping centers in France, with ample parking. The salon itself is discreet, but once inside, everything is designed for the comfort of both the animals and their owners.

Our Spitz was perfectly groomed: she left spotless, calm, and happy, which speaks volumes about the professionalism and gentleness of the team. The groomer took excellent care of her, and she was completely relaxed when we picked her up.

The prices are very reasonable, and the location is ideal for combining a grooming session with a little shopping or lunch in the neighborhood. We highly recommend this salon and will definitely return on our next visit to Lyon. See you soon!
